Root cause, and the evidence for each step

    

      
ClaimEvidence

      
Upstream renamed the event, not a flake2.1.268, 2.1.269 and 2.1.270 all reject a one line module with bare PreToolUse (2 or 3 args) and accept classic.PreToolUse.

      
It is real membership, not only shapeThe validator also accepts banana.PreToolUse, so the binary decides it: 2.1.270 defines a classic.PreToolUse dispatch site and executePreToolHooks routes shell PreToolUse hooks through it (8 string hits, 0 on 2.1.263).

      
It landed at 2.1.265 or 2.1.266, not 2.1.270Probe on @latest passed 09-08 07:08Z (2.1.263) and failed 09-09 07:08Z (2.1.266). npm: 2.1.265 at 09-08 19:05Z, 2.1.266 at 09-08 23:32Z.

      
Nobody announced itNo CHANGELOG bullet from 2.1.265 to 2.1.270 mentions it. The feature is still behind CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS.

    

  


  

    
What the fix does not do

    
It does not skip the probe, pin an older CLI, or loosen a match. It adds a pin: bare PreToolUse must be rejected with the exact message, so a revert upstream turns the probe red too. Mutation checks: reverted fixture fails, accepting CLI fails, wrong rejection reason fails, a 2.1.263 host skips with a named reason.
